meta.title: Kommz Hub | Creative communications agency, Kigali
meta.description: Kommz Hub is a creative communications agency in Kigali, Rwanda. Strategy, branding, digital marketing, creative production, PR and campaigns.

hero._help: video = the main video file. Use MP4 (H.264): it plays on every browser and phone. videoFallback = a second file the browser tries if the first is missing or cannot play, such as the original .MOV. poster = image shown while the video loads. overlay = how much to darken the video behind the text: 0 means fully visible, 0.4 means 40% darker. The video always plays muted on its own; soundButton shows a button visitors can use to turn sound on.
paragraphs: We are Kommz Hub, a creative communications agency based in Kigali, Rwanda.
We help brands and organisations find their voice, tell stories worth sharing, and build meaningful connections with the people who matter to them.
Through strategy, creativity, and thoughtful execution, we turn ideas into communication that makes an impact.

heading: Creative minds.
Clear thinking.
Meaningful communication.
about.lead: Kommz Hub is a Kigali-based communications and creative agency working with businesses, organisations, and institutions to develop ideas, tell stories, and connect with their audiences.
paragraphs: We believe good communication begins with understanding.
Understanding the people you’re speaking to. Understanding what your brand stands for. And understanding how every message, image, campaign, and conversation contributes to the bigger picture.
Our work brings together strategy, storytelling, design, digital marketing, public relations, and multimedia production.
Whether we’re helping a business build its online presence, producing a campaign, or developing a communication strategy, we approach every project with the same question:
about.question: What are we trying to achieve, and what’s the most effective way to communicate it?
about.closing: We believe the best work happens when creativity is guided by purpose.

philosophy.title: Clarity before creativity.
philosophy.text: We believe communication should be understood before it is admired.

philosophy.title: Creativity with purpose.
philosophy.text: A beautiful piece of content is only valuable when it serves a meaningful objective.

philosophy.title: Partnership over transactions.
philosophy.text: We take time to understand our clients, their businesses, and the challenges they’re trying to solve.

philosophy.title: Consistency builds trust.
philosophy.text: Strong brands aren’t built through one campaign. They’re built through communication that remains clear and recognisable over time.

items.title: Our Mission
text: To help brands and organisations communicate effectively through thoughtful strategies, compelling storytelling, and creative solutions that connect with their audiences.

items.title: Our Vision
text: To become a trusted creative communications partner for brands and organisations in Rwanda and beyond, recognised for work that combines creativity, clarity, and measurable value.

items.title: Our Approach
text: We don’t believe in creating content simply because something needs to be posted.
We believe every piece of communication should have a purpose, an audience, and a clear message.
That’s why we take time to understand the bigger picture before deciding what to create.

services._help: Each service has a button. link chooses where it goes. preselect fills the 'What can we help you with?' box in the contact form when the button is clicked (it must match one of the contact form options exactly, or be empty).
heading: Different expertise.
One connected approach.
intro: Good communication rarely happens in isolation.
A strong campaign needs a clear strategy. A compelling story needs the right creative execution. And great content needs a plan to reach the people it was made for.
We bring these disciplines together to help our clients communicate more effectively.

items.title: Communication Strategy
items.headline: Say the right thing, to the right people.
text: Before deciding what to communicate, we help you understand why it matters and who needs to hear it.
We work with brands and organisations to develop communication strategies that align their objectives, messages, audiences, and channels.

items.title: Brand Strategy & Positioning
items.headline: Know who you are. Make sure everyone else does too.
text: A strong brand is more than a logo or a colour palette. It’s what people understand, experience, and remember about your business.
We help brands define their identity, communicate their value, and build a consistent presence across every touchpoint.

items.title: Digital Marketing & Social Media
items.headline: More than posts. A presence with purpose.
text: Being visible online is important. But visibility alone isn’t enough.
We help businesses build meaningful digital connections through strategic content, thoughtful storytelling, and campaigns designed around clear objectives.
From developing a content strategy to managing day-to-day communication, we help brands show up consistently and communicate effectively.

items.title: Creative Production
items.headline: Stories people can see, hear, and feel.
text: Some stories are best told through a photograph. Others need a film, a conversation, or a carefully designed visual.
We bring ideas to life through creative production that captures attention while staying true to the message.
Whether it’s a commercial, documentary, brand campaign, or social media video, we focus on creating work that people connect with.

items.title: Public Relations & Media Relations
items.headline: The right story deserves the right audience.
text: How an organisation communicates with the public matters.
We help businesses and institutions communicate their stories, engage with the media, and build stronger relationships with the audiences and stakeholders who influence their reputation.

items.title: Campaigns & Creative Experiences
items.headline: Ideas that move beyond the brief.
text: Some messages need more than a single post or video.
We develop integrated campaigns that bring strategy, creativity, content, and audience engagement together around a shared objective.
From campaign concepts to execution, we help brands create experiences that people notice and remember.

work._help: filters = the filter buttons, in order. A filter with no matching project is hidden automatically. Each project's filters list decides which buttons show it. Leave image empty to show a designed cover with the client name (or coverText if you set one). video can be a YouTube link or an .mp4 file path. metrics: only rows with a value are shown, so leave value empty until you have a real figure. visualAssets is a reminder for you and is never shown.
heading: The work speaks.
Here’s what we’ve been saying.
intro: Every project starts with a different challenge.
Some clients need a stronger digital presence. Others need a story told, a brand introduced, or a campaign brought to life.
Here’s a look at some of the work we’ve developed with the brands and organisations that trust us.

items.title: Making Business Management Easier to Understand
items.categoryText: Digital Marketing | Content Strategy | Video Production
overview: Kayko is a Rwandan technology platform designed to help businesses manage their operations through digital tools.
Our work focused on translating the platform’s features into relatable stories and accessible content that business owners could understand.
Through educational videos, promotional content, and customer-focused storytelling, we helped communicate how technology can support everyday business operations.
items.contribution: Content strategy, video production, educational content, promotional campaigns, and digital storytelling.
items.visualAssets: Actual Kayko videos, business-owner interviews, production photographs, campaign creatives.

items.title: Bringing Home Inspiration to Life
overview: Oasis Interiors offers home furnishings and lifestyle products.
Our work has focused on showcasing its collections through visually engaging content, lifestyle storytelling, and promotional campaigns.

From product-focused videos to seasonal campaigns and influencer collaborations, we’ve worked to make the brand’s digital presence more engaging and connected to the way customers experience their homes.
items.contribution: Social media management, photography, video production, campaign development, and influencer collaborations.
items.visualAssets: Showroom photography, product videos, campaign materials, approved influencer content.

items.title: A Brand That Shows Up Beyond the Store
items.categoryText: Digital Marketing | Social Media | Content Production
overview: Our work with F & Y has focused on communicating the breadth of its products and services through consistent digital storytelling.
From corporate uniforms and branded merchandise to retail products and gift collections, we develop content that helps customers understand what the business offers and why it matters.
items.contribution: Social media management, content planning, photography, promotional videos, and campaign development.
items.visualAssets: Corporate uniform photography, branded products, gift collections, social media campaigns, behind-the-scenes production.

items.title: Making Complex Business Tools Simple to Understand
overview: Enterprise management software can be difficult to explain through conventional advertising.
For Moja ERP, our creative approach focuses on connecting the platform’s capabilities to the everyday challenges businesses face, using relatable storytelling and visual concepts.
The objective is to make the benefits of integrated business management easier to understand.
items.contribution: Creative concept development, promotional video production, and campaign messaging.
items.visualAssets: The actual campaign film, behind-the-scenes production, approved campaign visuals.

items.title: Three Brands. One Shared Purpose.
items.client: The Giving Edit: Oasis Interiors, The Nook and The Nest & Beyond
overview: The Giving Edit brought together three lifestyle brands around a shared charitable initiative.
Our communication work focused on presenting the collaboration through a unified campaign identity, storytelling, and promotional content.
By bringing the participating brands under one message, the campaign sought to encourage customer participation while communicating the purpose behind the initiative.
items.contribution: Campaign communication planning, creative direction, video production, and promotional content.
items.visualAssets: Campaign identity, founder videos, promotional materials, event photographs.

team.heading: Meet the people behind the ideas.
intro: Behind every campaign, photograph, strategy, and production is a team of people who care about getting the details right.
At Kommz Hub, we bring together different perspectives and creative skills, working collaboratively to deliver communication that serves our clients.
We believe great work comes from people who are curious, thoughtful, and willing to challenge ideas until they become better.

founder.name: Davis Higiro
bio: Davis Higiro is a communications professional and multimedia storyteller with experience spanning journalism, digital media, public relations, and creative production.
His work has involved developing stories, managing digital communication, producing multimedia content, and working with organisations to communicate their ideas to diverse audiences.
He founded Kommz Hub to bring together communication strategy and creative execution, helping brands approach storytelling with greater clarity and purpose.

upclose._help: The episode list comes from content/upclose.json, so episodes only need to be entered once.
heading: Beyond the headlines.
Into the stories.
intro: The Up Close is a conversation-driven podcast that explores the people, experiences, and decisions behind the stories we often hear only in passing.
Through honest, thoughtful conversations, the podcast creates space for guests to share their journeys, the lessons they’ve learned, and the experiences that have shaped who they are.
From entrepreneurs and creatives to professionals and changemakers, The Up Close is about getting to know the person beyond the title.

clients.heading: Good work is built together.
paragraphs: We’ve had the opportunity to collaborate with businesses, brands, and organisations across different industries.
Each partnership brings a new perspective, a different challenge, and an opportunity to create something meaningful.
We value the trust our clients place in us and the relationships we build along the way.
